_comment: Keyed by id from src/data/ritual20.ts (the BYRE 20-day morning/evening challenge).
Most items reuse a picture the habit or ritual sets already have; the rest are
generated into <item-id>.png. `image: null` means it still needs drawing.

r20-hvm-matcha.prompt: a bowl of ceremonial green matcha with a bamboo whisk resting across it, a small trail of steam

r20-movement.prompt: a rolled-out yoga mat with a pair of bare feet mid-step on it and a small low sun above

r20-rebounding.prompt: a small round mini-trampoline seen at a slight angle with a few motion arcs above it

r20-green-juice.prompt: a tall glass of vibrant green juice with a celery stick and a mint leaf beside it

r20-olive-oil-shot.prompt: a tiny glass of golden olive oil beside a lemon wedge and a single olive

r20-nourishment.prompt: a colourful breakfast bowl of oats, berries, seeds and yoghurt seen from above

r20-after-dark-coco.prompt: a warm mug of dark cacao with soft steam and a small crescent moon beside it

r20-legs-up-wall.prompt: a simple figure lying on their back with both legs resting straight up against a wall, seen from the side

r20-everything-shower.prompt: a shower head with soft steam curling below it and a small bottle and folded towel beside it

r20-visualisation.prompt: a calm abstract head in profile with a small soft cloud and two tiny stars floating above it
